title: Golden evaluation question
description: One JSON object per line in golden.jsonl. Only lines with verified: true are used.

answerable.description: false for questions the documents do not cover; the system should abstain.

relevant.description: Passages that answer the question. A retrieved chunk counts as relevant when it belongs to the scheme and, if given, the section.

verified.description: Set to true only after checking the question and answer against the source.
